task.instruction: Locate the most recent research paper about 'Algebraic Topology' under Mathematics published on ArXiv. Provide the title of the paper, the name of the authors, and the abstract.

final_answer:
The most recent paper with a primary classification of **Algebraic Topology (math.AT)** on arXiv is:

**Title:** Exotic smooth structures on complex projective spaces

**Authors:** Yueshi Hou, Hana Jia Kong, Zhouli Xu

**Abstract:** We study smooth structures on the topological manifold underlying complex projective space. We conjecture that every complex projective space ℂℙⁿ with n>3 admits an exotic smooth structure. We prove two results providing strong evidence for this conjecture. First, the set of complex dimensions n for which ℂℙⁿ admits an exotic smooth structure has natural density one. Second, we explicitly identify 266 congruence classes modulo 288 such that ℂℙⁿ admits an exotic smooth structure whenever n>3 lies in one of these classes. These classes cover more than 92% of complex dimensions, improving the previously known lower bound of approximately 36%. We prove these results by first relating the concordance group of ℂℙⁿ to suitable Atiyah–Hirzebruch filtration subgroups of its stable cohomotopy group, and then applying computations in chromatic homotopy theory at height 2.

**Details:** arXiv:2611.08406 [math.AT], submitted 5 November 2026 (18:13 UTC), DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2611.08406.

Note: one paper submitted slightly later that same day (2611.08415, "Shades and Convexity of Hypersurfaces" by Mohammad Ghomi, 18:18 UTC) is also cross-listed in math.AT, but its primary category is Differential Geometry (math.DG), so the paper above is the newest one whose primary subject is Algebraic Topology.
